build.text:
BUILD NOTES FOR TECH
• Age gate: client-side overlay on first visit to ANY page (deep links too). Yes sets a cookie (30 days if ‘Remember me’, else session); No shows the decline screen. Don’t block search crawlers or use a redirect.
• One hours source feeds the utility bar ‘Open today’ status, visit strip, footer and Visit page. Add holiday/weather closure banner.
• Calendar: keep The Events Calendar feed for ‘This week’ and ‘Coming up’.
• Order Online → existing Toast ordering page. Oktoberfest tickets → Toast.
• Spirits online → existing SharedPour collection; ‘Notify me’ on out-of-stock.
• Spirits, cocktails and draft list = CMS collections staff can edit.
• Menus: rebuild the PNG menus as HTML text (SEO + accessibility).
• 3D tours: link existing Matterport tours (Barn, Pavilion, Farmhouse).
• Inquiry form → events@ / weddings@ + CRM, with spam protection.
• Mobile: sticky bottom bar Order / Directions / Book.

images.text:
IMAGES
Every image slot is labelled with its exact file from the current site and carries a data-src with the full URL under flyingacefarm.com/wp-content/uploads/.
• Logo: FA_CircleLogo-main.png replaces the drawn FA roundel.
• Hero: existing Vimeo reel as muted loop; poster = 2507_image… (current OG image).
• Bottle shots: the 2022/09 and 2026/08 white-background files.
• Menus: MONKS-WINTER-MENU-2026-12.png, COCKTAIL-MENU-11.png.
